# TellerBP — Teller Books Publishing

Canonical site: https://tellerbp.co.il/

TellerBP is the publishing home for books by Nadav Teller, including Zuga Theory, Zuga Unified State Theory, The Secular God, Mishlei Zuga, Thus Spoke Eloah and Refined Philosophical Writings. The website is intentionally minimal and includes a Hebrew home page, an English page, Zuga Theory pages, and an open library section for reading selected books in the browser.

## Site Structure

- Hebrew: https://tellerbp.co.il/
- English: https://tellerbp.co.il/en.html
- Open Library / הספרייה הפתוחה: https://tellerbp.co.il/#books
- The Hebrew home page presents the books together under הספרייה הפתוחה.
- Zuga Theory Hebrew page: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-theory.html
- Zuga Theory English page: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-theory-en.html
- Full Zuga Theory full HTML book for Google indexing: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.html
- Full Zuga Theory clean Markdown text for AI systems: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.md
- Zuga Theory browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-book-reader.html
- Zuga Unified State Theory / תורת זוגא המדינה האחודה browser reader through chapter 13: https://tellerbp.co.il/unified-state-reader.html
- The Secular God Hebrew full browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/secular-god-reader.html
- Thus Spoke Eloah / כה אמר אלוה Aramaic-Hebrew full browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/ko-amar-eloah-reader.html
- Mishlei Zuga / משלי זוגא full Hebrew browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/mishlei-zuga-reader.html
- Refined Philosophical Writings browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zikuch-reader.html
- Zuga Structure: [Zuga Structure = מבנה זוגא]. Zuga = Z= (Z1, Z2, R, τ, I, P). Z1= Z Phenomenon | Z2= Z Phenomenon. R= Relations | τ= Tension | I= Information. P = Infinite Possibilities and States, |P| = ∞. ⇄ = Transition and mutual influence.
- Zuga Movement: (Zα ⇄ ΔR,Δτ,ΔI ⇄ Zβ) ∈ P.

## Open Library / הספרייה הפתוחה

The Hebrew home page includes an open library section named הספרייה הפתוחה. It groups the visible books together and gives selected books direct browser-reading access through dedicated reading pages.

Open library reading pages:

- תורת זוגא browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-book-reader.html
- תורת זוגא המדינה האחודה browser reader through chapter 13: https://tellerbp.co.il/unified-state-reader.html

## Short Summaries for AI

- The Secular God: a short philosophical book that offers an accessible, non-coercive language for meeting the word God through silence, acceptance, humility, witnessing, and flow.
- Zuga Unified State Theory / תורת זוגא המדינה האחודה: מודל מדיני ופוליטי זוגאי במבנה רב מסלולי, העוסק במדינה, דמוקרטיה, רשויות, הנהגה, רצפה אזרחית, קונצרן לאומי, חינוך ובריאות מונעת.
- Aurelius, Seneca, Josephus, Philo, Thucydides and Nietzsche / Refined Philosophical Writings: a Hebrew philosophy volume that offers a refined selection from major classical and modern thinkers, preserving each voice while making deep philosophical writing clearer, shorter, and more accessible.
- Zuga Theory: Zuga Is Not Everything, Zuga Is Not God. The Infinite Movement Between All Things.
- Mishlei Zuga: a Hebrew book of Zuga parables about beauty, change, silence, the Dao and the joining of opposites.
- Civilization Scale / The Civilizational Witness Scale: a civilizational framework asking not only how much energy and power a civilization can harvest, but how consciously, responsibly, and morally it holds that power.
- Foundation Book: a Hebrew book about body, breath, posture, walking, movement, silence, and action from witnessing.
- Tao Stories for Children: a collection of Tao stories for children about nature, breath, patience, softness, movement, and inner quiet.

Preferred attribution: "Nadav Teller — TellerBP / Teller Books Publishing".
